senses.gloss:
ITA-5.44.1 śvayathuḥ/ śothaḥ/ śophaḥ श्वयथुः/शोथः/शोफः
Oedema
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a feeling of heaviness; unstable/inconsistent/ shifting in nature; swelling; warmth; prominence of vessels; horripilation; discoloration; swelling between tvak and māṃsa.

ITA-6.2.6.67 śothaharaḥ, śothaghnaḥ, śvayathughnaḥ, śvayathuharaḥ शोथहरः, शोथघ्नः, श्वयथुघ्नः, श्वयथुहरः
Substance alleviating inflammation

ITA-5.20.1 śvāsaḥ श्वासः
Dyspnoea
A disorder characterized by difficult and hurried respiration.

ITA-3.2.4.37 kaṇṭhanāḍī, hṛdayanāḍikā, galanalakam, śvasanā, śvāsavahānāḍī कण्ठनाडी, हृदयनाडिका, गलनलकम्, श्वसना, श्वासवहानाडी
Trachea

ITA-6.2.6.70 śvāsaharaḥ श्वासहरः
Substance relieving dyspnoea

ITA-1.9.3.2.23 svatantra स्वतन्त्र
Independent
Autonomy; an attribute of soul (atma).

ITA-4.8.41 svatantra स्वतन्त्र
Primary disorder
A disease entity of independent etiology and pathology which has a direct bearing on associated conditions in terms of ultimate treatment outcome:

ITA-10.2.11 svapnam स्वप्नम्
Dream

ITA-6.2.7.11 niśi, svapnakālaḥ निशि, स्वप्नकालः
Administration of medicine at night before sleeping

ITA-6.2.6.75 svapnajananam स्वप्नजननम्
Somniferous, soporific
Substance tending to induce sleep

ITA-9.6.204 svabhāvaḥ स्वभावः
Natural removal of foreign body
The removal of a loosely impacted foreign body by natural means.

ITA-4.2.34 svabhāvabalapravṛttarogaḥ स्वभावबलप्रवृत्तरोगः
Conditions resulting from physiological variations or the ageing process
Diseases and conditions brought about by the natural progression of bodily processes such as hunger, thirst, sleep and old age.

ITA-9.8.8 svabhāvavyādhipratiṣedhīyarasāyanam स्वभावव्याधिप्रतिषेधीयरसायनम्
Rejuvenation therapy counteracting natural diseases
Rejuvenation therapy to prevent natural diseases such as hunger, thirst or greying of hair.

ITA-5.63.67 svaraghnam स्वरघ्नम्
Paralysis of vocal cords
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a feeling of entering into darkness constant respiratory distress; hoarseness of voice; dryness of throat; uncontrolled throat; obstructed/suffocated voice.

ITA-5.21.1 svarabhedaḥ स्वरभेदः
Hoarse voice, altered voice

ITA-7.1.6 svarasaḥ स्वरसः
Juice

ITA-7.2.5.2 svarṇam स्वर्णम्
Gold
Au (Aurum). Duly processed svarna is employed as a standalone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-7.2.2.4 mākṣikam/ svarṇamākṣikam माक्षिकम्/स्वर्णमाक्षिकम्
Copper pyrite, chalcopyrite
Copper iron sulfide (Cu2Fe2S4). In calcinated form makshikam is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.

ITA-6.2.6.32 svaryam स्वर्यम्
Substance enhancing the voice

ITA-1.6.35 svasañjñā स्वसञ्ज्ञा
Technical terminology limited to a school of thought
A technical terminology devised and used by only one school of thought.

ITA-9.6.183 svastikabandhaḥ स्वस्तिकबन्धः
Figure-of-eight bandage
A type of bandage applied to joints which resembles a figure of eight.

ITA-9.6.8 svastikayantram स्वस्तिकयन्त्रम्
Cruciform instruments
Cruciform instruments used in surgical and parasurgical procedures such as removal of an impacted foreign body in bone.

ITA-9.1.24 svastyayanam स्वस्त्ययनम्
Blessings from elders
A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease by receivingblessings (aśirvada) to cure the ailment.

ITA-10.1.1 svasthaḥ स्वस्थः
Healthy person
An individual in a balanced state of dosha, metabolism, structural components and excretion, with pleasantly functioning senses, mind and consciousness, all acting in harmony.

ITA-10.1.3 svasthavṛttaḥ स्वस्थवृत्तः
Routine(s) for health maintenance
Daily, seasonal and ethical regimens for the maintenance of health.

ITA-6.2.6.4 svasthavṛttahitam स्वस्थवृत्तहितम्
Maintaining well-being and good health

ITA-9.1.34 svasthasyorjaskaram स्वस्थस्योर्जस्करम्
Health-promoting
A medicine or regimen which boosts health in a healthy person; a feature of rejuvenative therapy.

ITA-7.2.1.20 svāṅgaśītam स्वाङ्गशीतम्
Left to cool, self-cooling

ITA-1.8.2.18 svārthānumānam स्वार्थानुमानम्
Inference for self
Obtaining the proof of inference for oneself.

ITA-10.1.2 svāsthyam, ārogyam स्वास्थ्यम्, आरोग्यम्
Positive attributes of health
A healthy state of body, mind and soul.
